title: Happy pig
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e87ba8'/>
  <rect x='46' y='84' width='8' height='10' rx='3' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <rect x='62' y='82' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e87ba8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M30 22 L26 8 L44 18 Z' fill='#e87ba8'/>
  <path d='M70 22 L74 8 L56 18 Z' fill='#e87ba8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='4' fill='#7a3b5e'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='36' r='4' fill='#7a3b5e'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='34.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffe6f2'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='34.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffe6f2'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#ff8fbf'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#a54b74'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#a54b74'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 63 Q50 70 60 63' stroke='#c25a86' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ff6fa6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ff6fa6'/>
  <!-- curly tail -->
  <path d='M80 62 q10 -2 8 -8 q-2 -5 -7 -2' stroke='#e87ba8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
